note: Sapper's Path bake (SPEC-v3 §5; v4 M3, the Siege to 100). Bands are Normal random-tap win rates. maxTaps caps the taps in any level (a linked pair is one tap, two cards). maxWaitMs: the dead-time cap, the longest single tap on the stored Normal line (patient play, from a tap until nothing moves). lookahead: the one-move-lookahead player's Normal win-rate target for late hard slots (a pick over it is logged). colours: [from, to, min, max] per level range. dealBy and genBy override deal/era params per band kind or slot. twists: which generated levels carry mystery cards, linked pairs and the lock (twistsOf in bake.js). fast: the fast tapper's check. mystery: the '?' flags and the sampling planner that measures them. Holding spaces per difficulty live in config.json v3.rules.

boss.note: Level 100, the boss fort: the biggest castle, both moats, four towers on the outer ring and three or four on the inner, every twist, twelve colours.

duration.note: Patient play-through time at 1x (engine ms) on the stored Normal winning line: tap, wait until every squad is home, tap again. Picks prefer candidates inside the limits; a pick outside is logged as a fallback. The median target is met by the generator sizes and squad sizes (v3.time only sets the swarm).

fast.note: The fast tapper (grade.fast: taps a random legal card the moment one exists). From level `from` on, a level is much easier tapped fast when fast - patient >= pts, or fast > ratio x patient and fast - patient >= minPts; the picker prefers candidates that pass.

twists.note: Generated levels from `from` carry the twist with probability p (fixed per level), forced after `gap` levels without it; from mixFrom every level carries at least one. mystery.cards: '?' flags per level; links.pairs: linked pairs per level.

mystery.note: '?' flags go on cards dealt in rows rows[0]-rows[1] of their column (0 = the front), never a linked card, never two in a row in one column. Each placement is measured by the sampling planner (grade.plan: games games, samples colourings per decision), honest and all-seeing; the first within maxGap is kept, else the smallest gap after tries (one flag fewer each try, never under 2).

genBy.note: Per slot: scale the era's board sides (per era). Reliefs are smaller and quicker.

penalty.note: Fallback picks (no candidate meets every target): the least total of band miss x band (per unit rate), duration miss / durationMs, dead-time miss / waitMs, fast x a fast-tapper flag, pairs x a missing pair, lookahead over its target / lookahead.
